_i18n.note: Machine-translated. Word anchors (until/push_at/merge_at/flip_at/chip.at/cursor.at) were position-remapped, not semantically translated - they pick the translated word at the same place in the sentence the English anchor held, so build.py never crashes on a missing word. Have a native speaker read lines + on-screen text before this ships; set reviewed: true after.
